# Cledger

> Cledger is a UK online accounting firm providing bookkeeping, VAT returns, payroll, management accounts and corporation tax services to UK small businesses. Fixed monthly fees from £175/month, all work delivered on Xero or QuickBooks, fully Making Tax Digital (MTD) compliant. Every client gets a private Slack channel with a response within one hour during UK business hours.

Key facts:
- Services: bookkeeping (from £175/mo), MTD VAT returns (from £99/mo), payroll with RTI submissions (from £99/mo), management accounts (from £149/mo), statutory accounts to FRS 102/105 and CT600 corporation tax filing, Self Assessment, 13-week cashflow forecasting
- Pricing: transparent, turnover-based, calculated instantly at https://www.cledger.co.uk/pricing — no setup fees, no lock-in
- Founded by Noor Muhammad (part-qualified ACCA, 4+ years UK public practice: VAT, CT600, payroll, management accounts, final accounts) and Ali Sajjad (ACMA — Institute of Cost and Management Accountants of Pakistan, MAAT, MSc Business Analytics)
- Software: Xero, QuickBooks, Sage, FreeAgent, Dext
- Sectors: dental practices, healthcare, construction and trades, property and landlords, eCommerce, contractors, freelancers, startups and SMEs
- Contact: info@cledger.co.uk · +44 7774 002712 · https://calendly.com/cledger-info/30min
- Registered office: 27 Jeremy Lane, Heckmondwike, WF16 9LT, England
